name: Behavior Bricks: Dragon Blast
author: timandjoshbricks
description:
‘Twas a nice summer’s day at the castle, until it was visited by the devastating, rock breathing, Stone Dragon. But not to worry! This castle has a Dragon Blaster. The only problem is, the power charger is outside the walls!!
Can you save the castle by charging the Blaster while dodging the on-slaughter of rocks?

[Instructions]
Tap the button to Jump.
Hold the button to charge the Blaster.
Gather 50 energy to Blast the Dragon.
5 Blasts to defeat the Stone Dragon.
*Made for the Lego Ideas one button contest.
